errors.quote: Switzerland's bunker network successfully deterred Nazi aggression during WWII
errors.reason: The video says the bunkers were only part of the deterrent, alongside Swiss banking and trade with the Nazis (48:52-49:09).

errors.quote: explains its eight-year ranking as the happiest country
errors.reason: The video only says preparedness 'might actually explain' the happiness ranking and offers other theories (coffee, saunas, wealth, belonging) (1:36:55; 2:24:36-2:25:04).
The video says one resort town, Famagusta, has been abandoned for 47 years (2:33:21), not multiple ghost towns.
